category_edits.rationale: Jointly test MAXLEN=64, batch size=256 and learning rate=1e-3 across all four datasets, retaining dropout=0.1. Shorter sequences reduce attention computation to accommodate larger batches; the increased learning rate complements the larger batch. The prior MAXLEN=64/LR=6e-4 regression makes this combination exploratory. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading preserve matching sequence dimensions. Model definitions, loss, Adam optimizer, seeds and training limits remain unchanged.

change_summary: Set shared defaults to MAXLEN=64, batch size=256 and LR=1e-3 for the four independently trained BERT4Rec category models; existing predictor metadata handles the changed history length.
